title: aria-label templates that wrap a value in English words still ship English under every locale — the kanban lane list reads "待规划 cards" under zh (outside the objectui#12145 / #12150 census instrument)
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible localization and accessibility defect. **reach:** a public entry, measured in the browser on the zh showcase task board (objectstack `66d456d01` `examples/app-showcase` `--fresh`). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 3 (`session_01Vk15bz8xHtKGUfXfCm16h4`) from the os-dev report on objectui#12716. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Family.** The literal `aria-label` census (objectui#12145, then #12150, both closed) pins literal strings, and its header puts interpolating template literals outside its instrument. #12150 says the template members it found were each translated or stated. These kanban ones were not, so the class has a gap the census cannot see.

**Reader who acts:** objectui triage. The first landing is `packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx`.

## Measured and read
- Each lane's list has the accessible name "待规划 cards" under zh: the column label inside an English template.
- In the same file and of the same shape (read from source): the swimlane cells ("TITLE - LANE cards") and the drag overlay ("Dragging TITLE").

## Expected
- Each such label is one bundle sentence with the value interpolated, in all ten packs.
- An enumeration pin covers interpolating `aria-label` templates, so the census instrument no longer stops at plain literals.

**Dedupe** (open and closed): every objectui `domain:ui` card (2433 rows) plus the newest objectui issues, grepped for `aria-label` near `template|interpolat` and for the kanban shapes. The only hit is objectui#12150 (closed), this family's previous card.

Dedupe words: aria-label template English, interpolated aria-label, kanban cards aria-label zh, Dragging overlay aria-label.
